messages:
deploy-bot: Deploybot noticed failing healthchecks on canary for release v1.12.3 in eu-west1; auto-rolled back to v1.12.2. More details: https://deploys.redwood/internal/3241599999 :warning:
Alex S.: Ack. Anybody know which change caused this?
Priya N.: Yep — it looks tied to the quant path change that landed in the tokenizer module in the last PR. Failing on longer sequences.
Sam K.: We should expedite a patch. Can we pin traffic to v1.12.2 until a hotfix is pushed? ops-oncall, any blockers for fastpath?
ops-oncall: I'm on call. No blockers from infra side if we have clear rollback criteria and a 60min observation window.
Megan L.: I'll cut a hotfix PR now and draft release notes. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/kv-quant-hotfix.md
Alex S.: Approving expedited path contingent on: feature flags off for new quant code, smoke eval after deploy, and auto-rollback on any error spike.
Priya N.: Noted. I'll disable the FF and prepare the smoke eval set `embed-regression-quickcheck`.
Sam K.: Deploy command we'll run (ops):
```
deploybot expedite --pin v1.12.2 --patch v1.12.3-hotfix --skip-canary --window 60m --owner alex
```
Megan L.: PR: https://git.redwood/patches/1234   Release note draft: "Hotfix: tokenizer quant-path stability". Posting final by +10m. :memo:
deploy-bot: Received expedite command from Alex S.. Starting controlled rollout with skip-canary flag. Notifying owners.
ops-oncall: I'll monitor traces and p50/p95. Rollback trigger: p50 +100ms OR errors >0.5% baseline for 5m.
Alex S.: Adding one more: if KV cache miss rate >3% for 10m, rollback.
Priya N.: Infra teams pinged: @infra-team please stand by to revert routing if latency > threshold.
deploy-bot: Rollout at 60% complete. Health checks passing so far. Telemetry: https://metrics.redwood/r/3241599999
Megan L.: Smoke evals running — no regression on our test prompts at +7m.
Sam K.: Will call an explicit rollback vote at +30m if anything looks off.
ops-oncall: Seeing a small p50 bump (~20ms) but within tolerance. No rollback.
Megan L.: Patch stabilized at +25m, metrics look steady. Posting final release note and tagging support.
Alex S.: Locking pin to v1.12.2 for 24h and filing follow-up ticket to roll the proper fix through canary later: https://issues.redwood/FT-987
Priya N.: I'll write postmortem notes and owner for root cause analysis. Thanks for the quick turnaround :heart:
Sam K.: Great job team — moving to monitoring phase. :raised_hands:
